text:
juniper (encops): heads up — during the RBAC rollout this morning the backup-uploader service lost the kms:Encrypt binding and ~12 snapshots were uploaded without CMK set. noticed in the audit log :grimacing:

samir (eng-infra): ugh. do we have object keys? can you paste sample head-object? :eyes:

juniper (encops): yes, sample head:
```
> aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key snapshots/2026-03-21/tenant42.snap
> {"ServerSideEncryption": "AES256"}
```

 tldr: SSE-S3, not SSE-KMS.

 tess (sec-ops): how many affected? severity? any PII?

 juniper (encops): ~12 snapshot files across 3 tenants. metadata scan shows no exposed PII but policy requires CMK for all backups. pointing to role-binding change in PR #782 that removed the kms grant from the uploader SA.

 samir (eng-infra): looking at the deploy logs — deploy-bot reports the new role removed this line: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from service account. rollback of RBAC will fix future uploads but we need remediation for existing objects.

 dave (oncall): created ticket INC-2026-0421 and started a re-encrypt job on a copy-bucket with workflow:
1) copy object with `--sse aws:kms --ssekms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/ABC`
2) verify head-object shows SSE-KMS
3) rotate pointer in snapshot index

 carla (product-security): please document timeline + notify affected customers per our encryption SLA. keep PR references and audit log snips.

 samir (eng-infra): commands we ran to find affected objects:
```
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-backups-prod --prefix snapshots/2026-03-21/ --query 'Contents[].Key'
for k in $(...); do aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key $k --query '{Key:Key, SSE:ServerSideEncryption}'; done
```

 juniper (encops): mitigation steps done: restored role binding, redeployed uploader (v1.3.7), kicked re-encrypt pipeline (copied 12 objects to redwood-backups-prod-reencrypt). monitoring checksum/size diffs. will run full audit to ensure no other snapshot dates impacted. :thumbsup:

 dave (oncall): flagging this for postmortem and a new guardrail: CI policy that rejects RBAC PRs that remove KMS encrypter role from uploader SA. cc @carla

 carla (product-security): agreed — require an automated policy + a dashboard alert when head-object shows AES256 on new uploads. also include a weekly audit job.

 deploy-bot: PR #789 rolled to prod, RBAC restored. Incident INC-2026-0421 created and assigned to eng-infra.

 juniper (encops): thanks all — continuing cleanup, will post final remediation notes when re-encrypt completes (~30m ETA).
